ORTHOPAEDIC SURGERY
Antimicrobial prophylaxis is not recommended for most clean procedures, including knee, hand or foot procedures, arthroscopy, or other procedures without implantation of foreign materials.

Prophylaxis is indicated for joint replacement, internal fixation, or hip fracture repair. Open fractures should be treated as infected.

Cefazolin is preferred for prophylaxis, as it is more active than vancomycin against susceptible staphylococci, the most common surgical pathogens.

Vancomycin should be used when methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus infection, in patients who are colonized or were recently infected with methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

Prophylaxis beyond 24 hours is not supported by current data and guidelines.

Longer durations provide no additional benefit and are associated with side effects, increased costs, and bacterial resistance.

Also, there is no evidence of benefit of antimicrobial administration until all drains or catheters are removed.

# Clean operations involving hand, knee, or foot and NOT involving implantation of foreign materials: (Select below)
*No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended
Prophylaxis for Total Joint Replacement

References:

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013, vol 70 pages 195-283
Therapy:
## Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

Prophylaxis recommendation includes q8h for 2 doses post-op. Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order from orthopedic standing post-op orders AFTER patient is admitted.

## Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

[Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision ($) [R]](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

Prophylaxis recommendation includes q12h for 1 dose post-op. Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order from orthopedic standing post-op orders AFTER patient is admitted.

## Known MRSA colonization:

[Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision ($) [R]](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)
Prophylaxis recommendation includes q12h for 1 dose post-op. Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order from orthopedic standing post-op orders AFTER patient is admitted.
